paper_title: Search for Axions in Magnetic White Dwarf Polarization at Lick and Keck Observatories
coupling_convention: |g_agamma| in GeV^-1, 95% CL one-sided upper limit as plotted on y-axis
notes: Paper reports world-leading 95% CL constraint |g_agamma| < 1.7e-12 GeV^-1 for m_a <~ 2e-7 eV from spectropolarimetry of MWD SDSS J033320+000720 (Lick/Kast). The limit is approximately mass-independent for m_a << 1e-6 eV (encoded as flat line spanning the plotted range down to ~1e-14 eV up to the stated validity 2e-7 eV); above that the limit weakens due to axion-photon dispersion mismatch, but no numerical values are extractable for the rising portion. Not a dark-matter search (relies on photon-to-axion conversion of MWD starlight), so no local DM density assumption. Other MWDs give weaker limits (4.2e-12, 5.7e-12, 1.0e-11, 1.6e-11 GeV^-1). | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.8, 39)) | Vision: Main new limit is the red curve in Fig. 1 (Kast/Lick observation of SDSS J033320+000720).
